if: the document is a revised tax invoice referred to in section 31
it is issued under rule 53(1) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the revised tax invoice MUST carry the taxable value, the rate of tax, and the amount of tax credited or debited to the recipient
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1)(i), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: value of taxable supply of goods or services, rate of tax and the amount of the tax credited or, as the case may be, debited to the recipient;
